name: create_website
description: Start a new full-stack website. Creates the website and a git repo from the standard template: a React 19 + TanStack Start app, server-rendered, in ONE Cloudflare Worker, with D1 / R2 / KV / Durable Objects / Containers available (all DISABLED by default). Returns a website_id — pass it to every later website tool. The 'type' param is REQUIRED and is the USER'S choice, not yours: unless the user has already made it unambiguous, ASK the user whether they want a plain website (no Higgsfield integration) or a Higgsfield-integrated app (Sign in with Higgsfield + AI image/video generation via the Higgsfield SDK) BEFORE calling this tool. Workflow: (0) call get_website_creation_instructions FIRST to load the stack, design contract, and hard rules (REQUIRED before building or editing); (1) create_website; (2) call website_repo_access to get the repo's git URL + scoped token, clone/edit/commit/push with the terminal; (3) deploy_website to ship it live.

type.description: REQUIRED — what the user chose to build. 'website': a standalone site with NO Higgsfield integration (no Sign in with Higgsfield, no requests to Higgsfield). 'app': a product tightly integrated with Higgsfield — its users sign in with Higgsfield and generate images/videos through the Higgsfield SDK. This is the user's decision: if their request doesn't make it obvious, ask them which one they want before creating.

subdomain.description: The website's subdomain — it becomes the slug, so the live URL is <subdomain>.<host>. ALWAYS set this: pick a short, memorable subdomain from the site's name or purpose (lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens only; DNS-safe). Only omit it — which falls back to a random subdomain — if the user explicitly asks for a random one. A few reserved labels (e.g. 'api', 'www') and already-taken subdomains are rejected; if that happens, try a close variant.

website_id.description: The new website's id. Remember it.

type.description: The product kind that was created: 'website' or 'app'.

request_id.description: MCP server HTTP request ID for support/debugging. If present, show it to the user.
